# Vendored SARIF 2.1.0 schema

- **File:** `sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`
- **Source URL:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/main/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json
- **Schema id:** https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json
- **Downloaded:** 2026-11-13
- **SHA-256:** `c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e`

This is the official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 JSON schema, vendored so the validation
test can run offline. It is **not** part of the published npm package: the
package `files` list contains only `src/`, `rules/`, `README.md`, and `LICENSE`.

## Licence

The schema is published by the OASIS Static Analysis Results Interchange
Format (SARIF) Technical Committee. The repository licence is reproduced in
`SARIF-LICENSE.md`:

> Property Rights (IPR) Policy, the TC Process, Bylaws, and the Technical
> Committee's choice of IPR Mode (viz., RF on RAND Terms Mode), including any
> applicable declarations.

The licence is therefore the OASIS RF on RAND Terms Mode, not an SPDX-listed
permissive licence. The schema is used here only as a test fixture; it is not
modified, redistributed in the npm package, or used at scan time.
